full_judgment: 2. Short facts leading to this Rule are that on 10-4-1990 the opposite party Nos. 1-5 and Aroti Rani Dey, mother of opposite party Nos. 6-9, as plaintiffs instituted Title Suit No. 34 of 1990 (subsequently renumbered as Title Suit No. 26 of 1991) in the Third Court of Joint District Judge, Khulna, impleading the predecessor of the petitioners and others as defendants for declaration of title in respect of 0.37 acres of land described in the schedule of the plaint, for declaration that the property described therein are not vested property, for recovery of khas possession and also for declaration that the orders passed by defendant No. 5 are illegal, collusive, inoperative and not binding upon the plaintiffs.
